```{r LOADING DATA AND PACKAGES, include=FALSE}
# --- Core packages ---
library(here)        # Reproducibilidad de rutas
library(tidyverse)   # Incluye ggplot2, dplyr, tidyr, readr, purrr, stringr, forcats, tibble
library(cluster)     # Matriz de disimilaridad

# --- Estadística ---
library(vegan)       # dbRDA y Rsq


# --- Visualización y clustering ---


# --- Genética ---
library(vcfR)        # read and manipulate VCF files

# Cargamos SMPs de los tres contextos
avena_CpG_meth_matrix <- read.table(here("avena_ncbi", "avena_ncbi_CpG_meth_matrix.csv"))
avena_CHG_meth_matrix <- read.table(here("avena_ncbi", "avena_ncbi_CHG_meth_matrix.csv"))
avena_CHH_meth_matrix <- read.table(here("avena_ncbi", "avena_ncbi_CHH_meth_matrix.csv"))
```

```{r MATRIX, include=FALSE}
#Transpose methylation matrix (individuals have to be rows)

# Distance matrix
daisy(avena_CpG_meth_matrix, metric = c("euclidean", "manhattan", "gower"),
      stand = FALSE, type = list(), weights = rep.int(1, p),
      warnBin = warnType, warnAsym = warnType, warnConst = warnType,
      warnType = TRUE)
```
